name: Foundational Security / InfoSec
description: Establish baseline security visibility across identity, endpoints, and core network paths for detection and investigation readiness.
technicalAddons: Splunk Add-on for Unix and Linux
Palo Alto Networks Add-on for Splunk
crawlDescription: Onboard AD, Windows security, and firewall or proxy logs with time sync and retention baselines; ship to a single index tier and publish perimeter-and-identity executive views.
walkDescription: Normalize to the Common Information Model, add EDR and DNS, tune volume caps, and stand up analyst queues with assignment and status for daily triage.
runDescription: Layer threat intelligence, correlation searches, risk scoring, and SOAR playbooks while running continuous content review and purple-team-driven tuning.
validationRules: Identity coverage must include strong authentication or directory-equivalent logs for interactive and privileged accounts.
At least one perimeter or east-west network telemetry source must be present with defined parsing and ownership.
valueProposition: You see who is accessing systems, what endpoints report, and what crosses defended network segments—enough to detect common attacks and start credible investigations. This profile pairs rapid time-to-value with a path to full SIEM maturity without boiling the ocean on day one.

name: Enterprise Security / SIEM
description: End-to-end security operations spanning hybrid identity, multi-channel telemetry, cloud control planes, and enriched detection at enterprise scale.
technicalAddons: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services
crawlDescription: Unify tier-1 on-prem and cloud ingress with ES workbench, standard fields across AD, perimeter, and EDR, and a single operational runbook library.
walkDescription: Bring in vulnerability, email, and cloud audit streams; align notables to MITRE, enrich with intel feeds, and integrate ticketing plus basic automation.
runDescription: Operate continuous detection engineering, automated containment options, risk-based prioritization, and executive SLA metrics across regions and business units.
validationRules: All five required domains must reach strong coverage with named data owners and parsing SLAs.
Threat enrichment must include at least one commercial or curated open-source feed with revocation and false-positive review.
valueProposition: Security leadership gains a single pane for hybrid incidents, not siloed alerts per tool. Analysts spend less time pivoting across consoles while executives see measurable reduction in dwell time and repeatable response.

name: Threat Detection and Investigation
description: Deep detection engineering and hunt-ready telemetry emphasizing endpoint, network, identity correlation, and intelligence-led investigation.
crawlDescription: Land high-fidelity EDR, DNS or resolver logs, and perimeter deny events with entity extraction (user, host, IP) for chained investigations.
walkDescription: Add NetFlow or NDR, cloudtrail-class signals, and stored hunt queries with evidence tagging; wire ATT&CK Technique views to data sources.
runDescription: Run purple-team cadence, automated hunt packages, detection-as-code promotion, and mean-time-to-detect dashboards with feedback to content owners.
validationRules: Endpoint telemetry must retain process and network-connection class fields needed for lateral movement analytics.
Intel feeds must be freshness-checked and scoped so production alerts do not rely on stale indicators alone.
valueProposition: Teams move from noisy alerts to explainable detection narratives that stand up in peer review. The same data supports both scheduled hunts and rapid incident reconstruction when minutes matter.

name: Risk-Based Alerting
description: Prioritize response using identity risk, asset context, and behavioral signals rather than flat alert volumes across the estate.
technicalAddons: Asset and Identity integrations via KV Store or CMDB lookup
crawlDescription: Join identity logs with a CMDB or asset feed and EDR heartbeats to score users and hosts into risk tiers with conservative thresholds.
walkDescription: Add SSO and privileged-access logs, vulnerability context, and peer baselines before routing only escalated composite risk to tier-two analysts.
runDescription: Automate dynamic watchlists, adaptive response actions for extreme scores, and monthly model governance with false-positive budgets.
validationRules: Asset inventory integration must refresh often enough that risk scores do not rely on stale ownership or classification.
Identity governance signals must cover both interactive sign-in and non-interactive application or service principals where applicable.
valueProposition: SOC queues shrink while severity alignment improves because analysts work highest-risk intersections first. Risk transparency helps IAM and infrastructure teams agree on remediation trade-offs.

name: Compliance and Audit
description: Evidence collection, access review, and reporting aligned to regulatory or internal control frameworks with defensible retention.
technicalAddons: Splunk Add-on for Unix and Linux
Splunk Enterprise Security Assets and Identities
crawlDescription: Centralize authentication and OS audit logs with immutable storage policy, time synchronization, and control-to-saved-search mapping for a pilot system.
walkDescription: Expand to databases and collaboration with RBAC aligned to control owners, scheduled evidence exports, and exception workflows.
runDescription: Operate continuous control monitoring with anomaly baselines, segregation-of-duties analytics, and audit-ready attestation packets per quarter.
validationRules: Audit evidence domains must be backed by WORM or legal-hold-capable indices where policy requires non-repudiation.
Asset context must tie users and systems to data scope so assessors can trace samples to populations.
valueProposition: Auditors receive repeatable evidence instead of one-off spreadsheet pulls. Internal teams cut prep time while reducing finding recurrence through earlier drift detection.

name: Identity and Access Monitoring
description: Continuous visibility into sign-ins, federation, SaaS administration, and privileged pathways across hybrid identity.
technicalAddons: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services
Palo Alto Networks Add-on for Splunk
crawlDescription: Ingest IdP sign-in and directory change logs with geo and device attributes, plus SaaS admin audit trails for priority applications.
walkDescription: Add VPN or ZTNA equivalents, cloud IAM API activity, and privileged session telemetry with lifecycle dashboards for dormant and over-privileged accounts.
runDescription: Deploy automated access certification support searches, impossible-travel class analytics, and integrated access revocation playbooks with ITSM.
validationRules: Authentication logs must attribute events to a stable user principal and application identifier across IdP and SaaS.
SaaS administrative actions must be retained for the period required by policy, not only end-user activity.
valueProposition: Identity teams detect account takeover and policy drift before spreadsheet reviews. Security operations gains a single timeline spanning on-prem AD, cloud IdP, and critical SaaS admin moves.

name: Endpoint Security
description: Endpoint-centric prevention, detection, and response with rich process, file, and network telemetry from managed devices.
crawlDescription: Deploy EDR or Sysmon-class feeds into normalized endpoint models with device class tags and basic prevalence dashboards.
walkDescription: Correlate endpoint events with threat intelligence and vulnerability severity; introduce response runbooks for containment and host isolation hooks.
runDescription: Mature with full incident reconstruction, automated ban lists, and fleet health scoring tied to patch and configuration compliance.
validationRules: Endpoint telemetry must include process lineage or an equivalent substitute for your EDR family to support root-cause analysis.
Coverage percentage by business unit must be tracked so blind spots are explicit, not assumed.
valueProposition: You close the gap where malware and hands-on-keyboard activity actually execute. Pairing EDR with identity and intel turns isolated alerts into decisive containment decisions.

name: Cloud Security
description: Security monitoring for public and hybrid cloud control planes, workloads, and federated access with posture context.
splunkApps: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services
Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform
technicalAddons: Splunk Add-on for CrowdStrike Falcon Horizon
crawlDescription: Land cloud audit and admin activity for each primary provider with account baselines, risky API monitoring, and identity linkage to corporate directories.
walkDescription: Add CSPM or CNAPP findings, workload agents, and Kubernetes audit where applicable; map to cloud MITRE tactics with composite notables.
runDescription: Automate misconfiguration detection pipelines, drift analytics, and cross-cloud incident timelines integrated with on-prem SOC queues.
validationRules: Cloud control-plane logs must include all production administrative partitions with tamper-aware delivery paths.
Authentication mapping must tie human and workload identities to enterprise identifiers for accountable response.
valueProposition: Cloud growth does not outpace visibility: the same SOC tackles IAM misuse, data exposure, and lateral movement in IaaS and PaaS. Posture and runtime signals together explain why an alert matters.

name: OT / ICS Security
description: Passive and safe monitoring of industrial networks, controllers, and operational events aligned to plant safety and availability.
technicalAddons: Splunk Stream for passive PCAP-derived metadata
crawlDescription: Mirror read-only OT zone traffic or historian exports with asset inventory and first-seen-device alerting without inline enforcement on day one.
walkDescription: Parse industrial protocols, align Purdue levels in tagging, and bring correlated IT VPN or jump-host logs for maintenance windows.
runDescription: Run IEC 62443-aligned use cases, fused IT-OT investigation timelines, and maintenance-change correlation with anomaly suppression during approved outages.
validationRules: OT collection architecture must be reviewed for fail-safe behavior so monitoring never jeopardizes process availability.
Industrial assets must be classified with owner and safety impact so alerts tier appropriately.
valueProposition: Plants gain modern detection without ripping out brownfield controllers. Engineers and security share a common asset truth that respects uptime constraints while closing blind spots attackers exploit.

name: IT Operations Monitoring
description: Service-centric IT operations combining logs, health signals, and transactional clues to restore and improve digital services.
splunkApps: Splunk Add-on for Unix and Linux
crawlDescription: Onboard OS and middle-tier logs with entity tagging and simple availability searches plus paging to the operations bridge.
walkDescription: Model business services in ITSI or equivalents, bind KPIs to golden signals, and integrate change records for faster correlation.
runDescription: Predictive alerting, automated remediation hooks, and executive reliability dashboards with error budgets and blameless review metrics.
validationRules: Service health definitions must map to customer-visible components, not only individual hosts.
Critical paths require agreed SLO sources of truth so alert storms align with business impact.
valueProposition: Operators stop swiveling between siloed tools when outages strike. Leadership sees whether investments in reliability actually shorten incidents and prevent repeat failures.

name: Infrastructure Monitoring
description: Capacity, utilization, and fault visibility for compute, storage, virtualization, and cloud substrate across the data center edge.
technicalAddons: Splunk Add-on for Unix and Linux
crawlDescription: Collect host metrics and hypervisor events with topology tags and baseline charts for CPU, memory, and disk saturation.
walkDescription: Add storage arrays and network device performance, align thresholds by environment class, and integrate CMDB ownership for paging.
runDescription: Capacity forecasting, automated right-sizing reports, and integrated FinOps views tying utilization to committed spend.
validationRules: Metrics granularity must support the shortest SLO window you promise internally (often one to five minutes) without destructive sampling bias.
Cloud and on-prem constructs must share a naming convention so composite dashboards stay trustworthy.
valueProposition: Infrastructure teams detect creeping saturation before tickets flood the queue. Finance and engineering use the same utilization narrative to plan refreshes and cloud migrations.

name: Application Monitoring
description: Log- and trace-driven insight into application errors, latency contributors, and dependency health for engineering and SRE teams.
splunkApps: Splunk Add-on for Java Management Extensions
crawlDescription: Instrument one critical service with structured logs and distributed traces, plus error budget panels for owners.
walkDescription: Link traces to infra metrics and DB slow queries, add deployment markers, and tune alert noise with SLO-based routing.
runDescription: Full application topology service maps, automated regression detection on releases, and integrated chaos experiment observability.
validationRules: Trace sampling must preserve enough headroom to debug tail-latency incidents without drowning storage.
Application logs must carry a stable service and version dimension for release comparison.
valueProposition: Engineers resolve customer-impacting defects faster because logs and traces tell a single story. Product and reliability leaders trust quantitative error and latency trends tied to releases.

name: Observability / APM
description: Full-stack observability with traces, metrics, logs, and experience telemetry to manage modern distributed systems.
crawlDescription: Stand up OpenTelemetry or vendor APM agents with unified service naming, RED metrics, and log correlation IDs.
walkDescription: Add RUM and synthetic checks for critical journeys, wire service maps to ownership in ITSM, and alert on burn-rate policies.
runDescription: Operate unified SLOs across browser, service, and data tiers with adaptive sampling budgets and continuous profiling in guard-railed production.
validationRules: Each golden signal must have an owner on-call rotation; orphaned metrics are removed to prevent dashboard debt.
Client-side and server-side telemetry must reconcile on session or trace identifiers for end-to-end investigations.
valueProposition: Teams see user pain and backend root cause together, cutting war-room time. Observability spend stays defensible because signal ties directly to revenue paths and engineering commitments.

name: Kubernetes / Container Monitoring
description: Cluster health, workload telemetry, security-relevant audit events, and application visibility across containerized platforms.
crawlDescription: Collect kube-apiserver audit, node and container metrics, and stdout logs with namespace and workload labels for chargeback tagging.
walkDescription: Integrate Prometheus endpoints, HPA events, and deployment pipelines; add trace propagation from ingress to pods.
runDescription: Advanced scheduling anomaly detection, image provenance correlation, and security policy violation analytics with GitOps change linkage.
validationRules: RBAC must restrict who can read production audit streams while still enabling SRE break-glass paths.
Label strategy must be enforced at admission so cost and team dashboards do not fragment.
valueProposition: Platform and product teams share live cluster truth instead of bespoke kubectl forensics. Incidents shorten when control-plane, node, and app layers align on one timeline.

name: Network Operations
description: Network performance, path validation, and fault isolation spanning LAN, WAN, and data-center fabrics.
splunkApps: Splunk Add-on for SNMP Modular Input
crawlDescription: Baseline device health and interface utilization with syslog plus NetFlow from core aggregation points.
walkDescription: Add overlay path analytics, Wi-Fi controller telemetry, and storage network visibility with topology-aware dashboards.
runDescription: Predictive capacity models, automated root-cause suggestions for multipath faults, and executive summaries on WAN spend efficiency.
validationRules: Flow coverage must represent both north-south and critical east-west segments or document explicit blind spots.
Device configuration backup correlation should exist for change-after-outage investigations.
valueProposition: NetOps stops guessing whether slowness is the app or the path. CFO-friendly views tie circuit utilization to renewals and cloud egress decisions.

name: Database Monitoring
description: Database performance, query patterns, replication health, and audit activity across relational and operational stores.
splunkApps: Splunk Add-on for Microsoft SQL Server
crawlDescription: Enable slow-query and connection telemetry with host resource correlation for tier-one OLTP systems.
walkDescription: Layer application request IDs, replication lag alerts, and backup job outcomes into unified DB owner dashboards.
runDescription: Automated anomaly detection on query plans, chargeback reporting by schema, and proactive index hygiene recommendations.
validationRules: Sensitive fields in database audit logs must be masked or tokenized per data-classification policy.
Sampling of high-volume queries must not hide worst-case tail latencies from monitoring.
valueProposition: DBAs and developers trust shared telemetry before escalating incidents. Capacity planning moves from seat-of-pants to measured growth in reads, writes, and storage.

name: Business Analytics
description: Line-of-business KPIs and operational analytics combining transactional systems with digital experience signals.
crawlDescription: Land PoS, order, or ERP extracts alongside web conversion funnels with daily refreshed dashboards for operations leaders.
walkDescription: Introduce near-real-time joins between transactions and latency or error metrics with alerts on KPI bands.
runDescription: Trusted data models, lineage documentation, and embedded analytics in enterprise portals with governed RBAC.
validationRules: Business metrics require defined owners and refresh SLAs so executives do not act on stale numbers.
PII in transactional feeds must comply with aggregation and retention policies before broad search access.
valueProposition: Finance and operations see the business pulse without waiting for overnight warehouse jobs. Splunk becomes a governed adjunct to the data lake for tactical decisions.

name: Customer Experience / Digital Experience
description: Measure and improve user journeys with real-user monitoring, logs synthesizing front-end friction, and backend correlation.
crawlDescription: Capture browser Core Web Vitals or mobile SDK events with geographic dimension and tie to synthetic uptime checks.
walkDescription: Expand journey funnels with session replay metadata where policy allows and correlate to service traces for failing pages.
runDescription: Experience SLOs drive release gates, marketing and engineering share cohort dashboards, and proactive fixes rank by revenue impact.
validationRules: Client telemetry must honor consent and regional privacy requirements before organization-wide rollout.
Synthetic scripts must mirror critical revenue paths and be version-controlled like application code.
valueProposition: Product teams prioritize fixes users actually feel, not only backend green dashboards. Support volume drops when digital friction surfaces before complaints flood the contact center.

name: AI / ML / Predictive Analytics
description: Operational data science on Splunk for forecasting, anomaly detection, and model-driven insights atop IT and business telemetry.
splunkApps: Splunk App for Data Science and Deep Learning
crawlDescription: Prepare curated feature datasets from metrics and logs with documented time zones, units, and entity keys for pilot models.
walkDescription: Deploy anomaly detection or forecasting on critical KPIs with human review queues before automated actions.
runDescription: Model registry discipline, drift monitoring, feedback capture, and integration with MLOps pipelines for retraining governance.
validationRules: Training data scope must be approved to avoid sensitive leakage into broadly shared Splunk roles.
Every production model needs rollback criteria and an owner responsible for false-positive cost.
valueProposition: Organizations graduate from static thresholds to adaptive analytics without standing up a separate science platform overnight. Business and IT leaders consume the same predictive signals with audit-friendly history.

name: Platform Administration / Splunk Health
description: Splunk platform reliability, indexer and search performance, ingest pipeline health, and capacity governance.
crawlDescription: Enable internal indexes, MC dashboards, forwarder phone-home health, and license usage tracking with ownership for nightly review.
walkDescription: Add data-quality checks, ingest latency SLOs, CMDB-enriched asset views, and automated ticket opening on WARN thresholds.
runDescription: Multi-site failover drill telemetry, indexer autosizing analytics, and FinOps-grade chargeback by index and BU with executive transparency.
validationRules: Platform administrators must have separate duties from security content owners where policy mandates separation.
Critical alert paths for search tier saturation must page 24x7 with written escalation trees.
valueProposition: Splunk administrators prevent user-facing outages and surprise license overages through foresight, not heroics. Stakeholders trust the observability estate because the platform itself is monitored like a product.

name: Custom / Other
description: Placeholder profile for bespoke programs, proofs of concept, or emerging domains not yet standardized in the catalog.
crawlDescription: Document objectives, data contracts, and stakeholder owners before ingest; start with a narrow event set and explicit success metrics.
walkDescription: Iterate parsing and field standards weekly with users; promote only fields that survive peer review and privacy checklist.
runDescription: If the program stabilizes, graduate requirements into a named profile with required domains and minimum sources for ongoing governance.
validationRules: Custom programs still require executive sponsor and data-governance sign-off even when domain lists are empty.
Retention, encryption, and access controls must match the most sensitive projected data class before scale-up.
valueProposition: Teams can explore new ideas without forcing a poor fit into rigid templates. Clear guardrails keep experiments safe while preserving a path to operational maturity once value is proven.
